The Loop is a product of the collective work of students across the five Claremont Colleges. Created by Circuits, Internet, Media, and Software, The Loop has published three issues -- one per active semester -- two of which you can scroll through below.

As a Co-founder, I am incredibly proud of the momentum, content, and community this magazine and organization has fostered in such a short amount of time, allowing me and my peers to grow as both artists, organizers, and multimedia fanatics. I've recently handed leadership off to underclassmen, as I'm about to graduate. See more about CIMS [here](https://claremont.campuslabs.com/engage/organization/circuits-internet-media-software).
